item.text: The failures converge on a few underlying issues: invitations are created without identity checks, expiry is calculated in hours, revoked/expired rows are counted incorrectly, and acceptance creates an “invited” membership without restoring archived rows. I’m checking the removal and session flows now so cleanup covers notifications, digests, and defaults too.

item.text: The core fixes are in place: acceptance now checks the invited email and deleted-workspace state, restores archived memberships, and marks members active immediately. Seat checks and displayed seat usage now use current members plus unexpired, unrevoked invitations; removal also clears that workspace from affected sessions and excludes former members from notification and digest delivery. I’m reviewing for type and import issues now.
